sources.title: Few Shot Prompting - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Few‑shot prompting is a technique in AI where a model is given a small number of examples within the prompt to guide its response. By learning from these examples, the model can better understand the task and generate more accurate and relevant outputs without additional training.
